Running Python code interactively: # Wait, the AlgorithmIdentifier at position 103 is just the OID + NULL?
# Let me re-examine

# Position 101: 30 0d - SEQUENCE of length 13
# Position 103: 06 09 - OID of length 9
# Position 104-112: 2a 86 48 86 f7 0d 01 01 01 - rsaEncryption
# Position 113: 05 00 - NULL
# Position 115: 03 - BIT STRING

# Wait, that doesn't add up. Let me re-examine
print(f"Bytes 100-120: {cert_der[100:120].hex()}")

# 100: ??
# 101: 30 - SEQUENCE tag
# 102: 0d - length 13
# 103: 06 - OID tag
# 104: 09 - OID length 9
# 105-113: 2a 86 48 86 f7 0d 01 01 01 - rsaEncryption
# 114: 05 - NULL tag
# 115: 00 - NULL length
# 116: 03 - BIT STRING tag

# So the AlgorithmIdentifier is at 101-115 (15 bytes)
# 30 0d 06 09 2a 86 48 86 f7 0d 01 01 01 05 00

# I need to replace this with:
# 30 0b 06 09 2a 86 48 86 f7 0d 01 01 0a 30 00 (15 bytes)

# Wait, the new one is also 15 bytes! So I don't need to update any lengths!
# Let me verify

old_algo = bytes([0x30, 0x0d, 0x06, 0x09, 0x2a, 0x86, 0x48, 0x86, 0xf7, 0x0d, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x05, 0x00])
new_algo = bytes([0x30, 0x0b, 0x06, 0x09, 0x2a, 0x86, 0x48, 0x86, 0xf7, 0x0d, 0x01, 0x01, 0x0a, 0x30, 0x00])

print(f"Old algo length: {len(old_algo)}")
print(f"New algo length: {len(new_algo)}")
print(f"Same length: {len(old_algo) == len(new_algo)}")

# Replace
cert_der[101:116] = new_algo

# Verify
print(f"\nAfter replacement, bytes 100-120: {cert_der[100:120].hex()}")
print(f"Expected: 30 0b 06 09 2a 86 48 86 f7 0d 01 01 0a 30 00 03")

# Now I need to construct the OCSP response containing this certificate
print(f"\nModified certificate DER length: {len(cert_der)}")
